design: Fit mean raw query edits on H566 first four lexical pairs only, per task/phrase/head. Freeze before evaluating four new name pairs. Compare phase-only, learned first-query shift and learned both-query shifts. No outcome-based selection. Insert text strictly after selected name. Fixed heads, no case selection. Compute rotary-only predictions from base prompts before evaluating edited prompts.
scope: Physical edits change query context as well as distance. No claim of pure position manipulation. Coefficient interventions touch only the selected persistent-bus edge; other prompt-induced changes remain.
